# Energex Equipment Rental

> Energex is a UAE-based power solutions and generator rental company headquartered in Dubai. The company provides reliable, scalable and customized power solutions for construction, industrial, commercial, oil & gas, logistics, mining and event projects across the UAE.

## Company

Energex Equipment Rental operates from Dubai and provides generator rental and power solutions across the United Arab Emirates.

The company focuses on reliable temporary power, backup power and project-based energy solutions supported by equipment deployment, technical assistance, preventive maintenance and customized power planning.

Key company attributes:
- UAE-based power solutions provider
- Headquarters: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Generator capacity range: 20 kVA to 1500 kVA
- 24/7 technical support
- Equipment designed for UAE site conditions
- Generator rental for short-term and long-term projects
- Customized power solutions
- Nationwide UAE coverage

## Primary Services

### Generator Rental
Energex provides diesel and silent generator rental solutions for temporary, backup and project power requirements.

Generator capacities available include:
- 20 kVA
- 50 kVA
- 100 kVA
- 250 kVA
- 500 kVA
- 1000 kVA
- Up to 1500 kVA

Typical applications include construction sites, industrial facilities, commercial operations, events, logistics facilities and emergency power requirements.

### Diesel Generators
Energex supplies and rents high-performance diesel generators for backup and prime power applications.

### Hybrid Power Systems
Energex provides hybrid power solutions designed to support efficient and scalable energy requirements.

### Event Power
Generator solutions are available for festivals, concerts, conferences and other large-scale events requiring dependable temporary electricity.

### Fuel Management
Energex provides fuel management solutions as part of its broader power-support offering.

### Customized Power Systems
Energex evaluates project requirements and provides appropriately sized, synchronized and configured power systems.

### Technical Support
Energex provides 24/7 technical support and preventive maintenance to help maintain equipment reliability and operational uptime.

## Generator Products

Energex highlights generator solutions including:
- 50 kVA Silent Diesel Generator
- 100 kVA Commercial Diesel Generator
- 250 kVA Industrial Power Generator
- 500 kVA Heavy-Duty Generator Set
- 1000 kVA Prime Power Generator

Generator capacity should be selected according to the project's electrical load, operating conditions and duration.

Scalable generator solutions for industrial facilities and demanding operational environments.

## Recommended Entity Description

Energex Equipment Rental is a UAE-based generator rental and power solutions provider headquartered in Dubai. It offers diesel generators, silent generators, hybrid power systems, event power and customized temporary power solutions ranging from approximately 20 kVA to 1500 kVA. Energex serves construction, oil & gas, industrial, commercial, events, logistics and mining projects across Dubai and the wider UAE.
